title.en: Senegal's president sacks prime minister Sonko after months of tensions
title.zh: 紧张局势数月后塞内加尔总统解雇总理桑科

summary.en: Bassirou Diomaye Faye also dissolved the government, creating uncertainty amid a debt crisis in the country.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Senegalese President Bassirou Diomaye Faye has sacked Prime Minister Ousmane Sonko and dissolved the nation's government after months of tensions between the two men.

A shock decree, read out on TV by a presidential aide, said Faye had "ended the duties of Ousmane Sonko... and consequently those of the ministers and secretaries of state who are members of the government".

Sonko, a popular figure among Senegal's youth, said on social media that he would "sleep with a light heart".

The split comes as the country faces mounting economic pressure, with its public debt having reached the equivalent of 132% of its GDP, according to the International Monetary Fund (IMF).

Sonko's dismissal followed a parliamentary session on Tuesday, during which the prime minister openly criticised Faye.

Faye was in the unusual situation of owing his position, in large part, to his prime minister's popularity.

Sonko would almost certainly have taken the top job had he not been barred from running in 2024's elections due to a defamation conviction .

However, Sonko backed Faye's bid for presidency and the pair went on to win - an extraordinary victory given they were both in prison until 10 days before the election .

Late on Tuesday night, several hundred students demonstrated on the streets of capital city, Dakar, declaring their support for Sonko.

Faye had reportedly criticised Sonko's "excessive personalisation" within the ruling party Pastef, while Sonko accused the president of a "failure of leadership" for not defending him against his critics.
body.zh: 塞内加尔总统巴西鲁·迪奥马耶·法耶解雇了总理奥斯曼·松科，并解散了该国政府，两人之间的紧张关系持续了数月。 总统助手在电视上宣读了一项令人震惊的法令，称费耶“终止了奥斯曼·桑科的职责……以及政府成员中的部长和国务卿的职责”。 塞内加尔年轻人中颇受欢迎的人物松科在社交媒体上表示，他会“轻松地睡觉”。 根据国际货币基金组织 (IMF) 的数据，该国面临着越来越大的经济压力，其公共债务已达到相当于 GDP 的 132%。 松科在周二的议会会议后被解职，会上总理公开批评了费耶。 费耶的处境很不寻常，他的地位在很大程度上要归功于他的总理的声望。 如果桑科没有因诽谤罪被禁止参加 2024 年选举，他几乎肯定会担任最高职务。 然而，桑科支持费耶竞选总统，两人最终获胜——这是一次非凡的胜利，因为他们直到选举前 10 天都在监狱里。 周二深夜，数百名学生在首都达喀尔街头示威，宣布支持桑科。 据报道，费耶批评桑科在执政党巴斯夫内部“过度个人化”，而桑科则指责总统“领导失败”，因为他没有为他的批评者辩护。

reflection.en: This story draws attention to leadership, wisdom, and public responsibility. Proverbs 11:14 reminds us to meet sharp headlines with wisdom, integrity, and service, asking how faithful people can respond with wisdom instead of noise.

title.en: Gaza flotilla activists allege abuse by Israeli forces while detained
title.zh: 加沙船队活动人士指控被以色列军队拘留期间遭受虐待

summary.en: Detainees from a Gaza flotilla claim they were subjected to slapping, hitting, humiliation, and sexual violence by Israeli forces. Israel's prison service, however, denies these allegations, stating they are false.
summary.zh: 一支加沙船队的被拘留者声称，他们在被以色列军队拘留期间遭受了掌掴、殴打、羞辱甚至性暴力。然而，以色列监狱部门否认了这些指控，称其不实。

body.en:
Pro-Palestinian activists deported after their Gaza-bound aid flotilla was intercepted in international waters by Israeli forces have alleged they were subjected to abuse while held in detention.

Canada said it had received information detailing "appalling abuse" of its citizens, while Germany and Spain confirmed that a number of their citizens had injuries.

The flotilla's organisers alleged there were "at least 15 cases of sexual assaults" while other people who were detained said they were beaten and mistreated.

The BBC has not been able to independently verify the allegations. Israel's prison service has dismissed them as false, saying all detainees were "held in accordance with the law".

The Israeli military similarly rejected the allegations, telling the BBC that its orders "require respectful and appropriate treatment of flotilla participants".

More than 50 boats in the Global Sumud Flotilla (GSF) set sail from Turkey last week, planning to breach Israel's maritime blockade of Gaza and deliver food and medical aid.

Israel's government dismissed the action as a "PR stunt" serving the Palestinian armed group Hamas, and ordered commandos to board the boats west of Cyprus on Monday and Tuesday.

The detained activists were transferred to Israeli vessels and taken to an Israeli prison after arriving at the port of Ashdod.

On Thursday, 422 people from 41 countries were deported by Israel. Many have since arrived home.

Canadian Foreign Minister Anita Anand said on Friday that she had "received information from my officials which details the appalling abuse of Canadians who were detained in Israel", without giving further details.

She added: "Canada unequivocally condemns the grave mistreatment of Canadians in Israel. Those responsible for this egregious abuse must be held accountable."

A spokesperson for Germany's foreign ministry said its consular officials had met German activists on arrival in Istanbul on Thursday and reported that a number were injured.

Humane treatment of German nationals was an "absolute priority", they added. "We naturally expect a full explanation, as some of the allegations that have been made are serious."

Spanish Foreign Minister José Manuel Albares told reporters that four of the 44 Spanish activists had received medical treatment for injuries.

Organisers of the Global Sumud Flotilla also said on Friday: "At least 15 cases of sexual assaults, including rape. Shot with rubber bullets at close range. Tens of people's bones broken."

Israel's prison service said in a statement that various allegations were "false and entirely without factual basis".

body.zh: 前往加沙的援助船队在国际水域被以色列军队拦截后被驱逐出境的亲巴勒斯坦活动人士声称，他们在拘留期间受到虐待。 加拿大表示，已收到详细描述其公民遭受“令人震惊的虐待”的信息，而德国和西班牙则证实，一些公民受伤。 该船队的组织者声称存在“至少 15 起性侵犯案件”，而其他被拘留的人则表示他们遭到殴打和虐待。 BBC 尚未能够独立核实这些指控。以色列监狱部门认为这些内容是虚假的，并称所有被拘留者都是“依法关押的”。 以色列军方同样拒绝了这些指控，并告诉英国广播公司，其命令“要求尊重和适当对待船队参与者”。 全球苏姆德船队 (GSF) 的 50 多艘船只上周从土耳其起航，计划突破以色列对加沙的海上封锁，运送食品和医疗援助。 以色列政府驳斥了这一行动，称其为为巴勒斯坦武装组织哈马斯服务的“公关噱头”，并命令突击队于周一和周二登上塞浦路斯西部的船只。 被拘留的活动人士抵达阿什杜德港后被转移到以色列船只上并被带到以色列监狱。 周四，来自 41 个国家的 422 人被以色列驱逐出境。许多人已经回到家中。 加拿大外交部长安妮塔·阿南德周五表示，她“从我的官员那里收到了信息，其中详细描述了在以色列被拘留的加拿大人遭受的令人震惊的虐待”，但没有提供更多细节。 她补充说：“加拿大明确谴责在以色列严重虐待加拿大人的行为。必须追究那些对这种严重虐待行为负责的人的责任。” 德国外交部发言人表示，其领事官员周四抵达伊斯坦布尔时会见了德国活动人士，并报告称有一些人受伤。 他们补充说，对德国国民的人道待遇是“绝对优先事项”。 “我们自然期望得到完整的解释，因为一些指控是严重的。” 西班牙外交部长若泽·曼努埃尔·阿尔瓦雷斯告诉记者，44 名西班牙活动人士中，有 4 人因受伤接受了治疗。 Global Sumud Flotilla 的组织者周五还表示：“至少有 15 起性侵犯案件，其中包括强奸。用橡皮子弹近距离射击。数十人骨折。” 以色列监狱部门在一份声明中表示，各种指控都是“虚假的，完全没有事实依据”。 “所有囚犯和被拘留者均依法关押，充分尊重他们的基本权利，并在经过专业培训的监督下......

reflection.en: When serious allegations of abuse are met with firm denials, it highlights the challenge of discerning truth. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that the first account often seems right until the other side is heard and examined. In such complex situations, a patient and thorough pursuit of facts is essential for justice and clarity.

title.en: Putin vows retaliation after accusing Ukraine of hitting student dormitory
title.zh: 俄罗斯总统普京在指责乌克兰袭击学生宿舍后誓言报复

summary.en: Russian President Vladimir Putin has vowed retaliation, accusing Ukraine of striking a student dormitory. Ukraine, however, stated its forces targeted Russia's elite Rubicon drone military unit in an area of eastern Ukraine occupied by Moscow.
summary.zh: 俄罗斯总统普京在指责乌克兰袭击学生宿舍后誓言报复。然而，乌克兰表示，其部队袭击了俄罗斯在莫斯科占领的乌克兰东部地区的一支精锐的鲁比肯无人机军事单位。

body.en:
Vladimir Putin has promised retaliation after accusing Ukraine of carrying out a deadly attack on a student dormitory in an occupied part of eastern Ukraine.

Ten people were killed and 38 others injured in the overnight strike in the town of Starobilsk, in the Luhansk region, the local Russian-backed governor said. Another 11 people remain missing, he said.

Ukraine's military said it had hit the headquarters of Russia's elite Rubicon drone military unit in Starobilsk. It did not say whether it was the same building as the one identified by Russia.

But Putin said there were "no military facilities, intelligence service facilities or related services in the vicinity".

"Therefore, there is absolutely no basis for claiming that the munitions struck the building as a result of our air defence or electronic warfare systems," he said at a reception in his Kremlin residence in Moscow on Friday.

The Russian leader said the Ukrainian strike had been carried out in three waves using 16 drones.

Russia's state-run TV showed what it said was one of the injured students, identifying her as Diana Shovkun, aged 19.

She had head injuries after being hit by a collapsing concrete slab, the report said.

Early on Saturday, Russian officials reported two people had been injured after falling debris from drones triggered a fire at an oil depot in Russia's Black Sea port of Novorossiysk.

The general headquarters of the southern Krasnodar region said "several technical administrative buildings caught fire" and fragments of drones fell on a fuel terminal.

Two people were injured and were being treated in hospital, the headquarters said. No deaths were reported.

The general headquarters said drones had also damaged private homes in the port city of Anapa further north.

Ukraine's military said late on Friday that an overnight strike had targeted Rubicon's headquarters in Starobilsk. It accused fighters from the special drone unit of regularly striking civilians and civilian infrastructure in Ukraine.

The statement also said that Ukrainian forces were "causing damage to military infrastructure and facilities used for military purposes, strictly adhering to the norms of international humanitarian law, laws and customs of war".

On Thursday, Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky said the headquarters of Russia's security service FSB had been hit in the Moscow-seized area of Ukraine's southern Kherson region.

Moscow's military has not commented on the issue, but one pro-Kremlin Telegram channel reported "casualties" after what it described as a "massive drone strike".

Ukraine has repeatedly accused Russia's military of deliberately targeting civilians since the start of Moscow's full-scale invasion in 2022 - a charge Moscow regularly denies.

reflection.en: In times of conflict, the impulse to retaliate can perpetuate cycles of harm, making true resolution elusive. The biblical call to overcome evil with good reminds us that breaking these cycles requires a different kind of strength, one that seeks constructive paths even amidst provocation.
reflection.zh: 在冲突时期，报复的冲动可能使伤害的循环持续下去，使真正的解决难以实现。圣经中以善胜恶的呼召提醒我们，打破这些循环需要一种不同的力量，一种即使在挑衅中也寻求建设性道路的力量。

title.en: Can the Quad stay relevant to boost Indo-Pacific security?
title.zh: 四方机制能否保持影响力以促进印太安全？

summary.en: Foreign ministers from the US, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.
summary.zh: 这是一则来自全球栏目的新闻，重点涉及领导、智慧与公共责任。如需完整细节，请阅读英文原始报道。

body.en:
Foreign ministers from the US, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

Foreign ministers from the US , India, Japan and Australia — the four nations that make up the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, better known as the Quad — are set to meet in New Delhi over three days from Sunday to discuss Indo-Pacific security, energy supplies and emerging technologies.

The meeting comes as China continues to test geopolitical and security boundaries in the region.

But it's another issue, which is not on the agenda, that looms large over the gathering: how to keep the alliance alive and relevant in an ever more challenging geopolitical landscape and an increasingly assertive China .

The Quad, which unites the four nations in seeking a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP), has not had a meeting of national leaders since 2024, when then-President Joe Biden hosted his counterparts in Wilmington, Delaware.

India was meant to host the next annual meeting in the latter part of 2025, but that never materialized amid tensions between India and the new administration of President Donald Trump .

Trump has imposed tariffs and punitive duties on Indian imports to the US, straining ties with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The US president further antagonized New Delhi by claiming to have mediated a settlement to border clashes between India and Pakistan in May last year . The US president was also critical of India purchasing Russian military equipment .

One year on, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is heading the US delegation to India, is tasked with smoothing ruffled diplomatic feathers. With Trump's attention apparently focused on the war in the Middle East and, potentially, Cuba , Rubio's mission could be a challenging one.

"The US, Japan and Australia already had an important and effective trilateral security arrangement, but the whole purpose of the Quad was to bring India in as another power to give it more influence and reach," said James Brown, a professor of international relations at the Tokyo campus of Temple University.

"Unfortunately, this US administration does not seem to have grasped that or valued India's presence as an ally, which has badly alienated Modi," he told DW.

Japan and Australia have made efforts to keep the four-way alliance intact and functioning, with Brown suggesting that the Quad might actually benefit from the US being represented by Rubio, rather than Trump, in India.

title.en: Reeves makes case to remain as chancellor with reports Burnham may favour Miliband
title.zh: 里夫斯力争留任财政大臣，有报道称伯纳姆可能支持米利班德

summary.en: Rachel Reeves is reportedly campaigning to retain her position as Chancellor, with her supporters arguing she is the only candidate capable of safeguarding the UK's finances amidst potential leadership changes.
summary.zh: 据报道，雷切尔·里夫斯正在争取保留其财政大臣的职位，她的支持者称，在潜在的领导层变动中，她是唯一能够保障英国财政的候选人。

body.en: Chancellor’s supporters urge MPs to back her if Keir Starmer is replaced, saying she is only candidate who can safeguard UK’s finances Rachel Reeves has launched a rearguard action to save her job as chancellor, telling friends she would like to stay in the post even under a new prime minister. The chancellor’s supporters have been urging MPs to back her if Keir Starmer is replaced later this year, saying she is the only candidate who can safeguard the country’s finances. Continue reading...
body.zh: 英国财政大臣的支持者敦促国会议员在凯尔·斯塔默被替换时支持她，称她是唯一能够维护英国财政的候选人。雷切尔·里夫斯发起了一项后卫行动，以保住她的财政大臣职位，并告诉朋友们，即使在新首相的领导下，她也希望继续留任。总理的支持者一直敦促国会议员在凯尔·斯塔默(Keir Starmer)今年晚些时候被取代的情况下支持她，称她是唯一能够维护国家财政的候选人。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the intricate world of political leadership, individuals often make their case for retaining or gaining power, citing their unique qualifications and vision. This reminds us that while human effort and strategy are at play, the ultimate appointment to positions of influence rests with a higher power.
reflection.zh: 在复杂的政治领导世界中，个人常会陈述其保留或获得权力的理由，援引其独特的资历和愿景。这提醒我们，尽管人类的努力和策略在发挥作用，但最终任命有影响力职位的主权在于更高的权柄。

verse.textEn: It is God who judges: He brings one down, he exalts another.
verse.textZh: 惟有神断定；他使这人降卑，使那人升高。

title.en: Fraudster trying to sell fake ancient statues to Sotheby’s foiled over bogus invoices
title.zh: 欺诈者因伪造发票试图向苏富比出售假古董雕像而败露

summary.en: Andrew Crowley, 46, attempted to sell fake ancient statues to Sotheby's. His fraud was uncovered when accompanying paperwork, intended to authenticate the items, was found to have been produced using printing methods that were 25 years too modern for the supposed age of the documents.
summary.zh: 46岁的安德鲁·克劳利试图将伪造的古代雕像出售给苏富比拍卖行。他的欺诈行为被识破，因为随附的旨在证明物品真实性的文件，被发现使用了比文件声称的年代晚25年的印刷技术。

body.en: Paperwork supplied by Andrew Crowley, 46, found to be made using printing methods 25 years too modern A fraudster who tried to sell fake ancient statues to Sotheby’s was foiled when his bogus accompanying paperwork was found to be written with printing methods that were 25 years too modern, a court has heard. Andrew Crowley, 46, asked the auctioneers to value three Cycladic figures and one Anatolian stargazer statuette that he had inherited from his grandfather, Southwark crown court in London was told on Friday. Continue reading...
body.zh: 46 岁的安德鲁·克劳利 (Andrew Crowley) 提供的文件被发现使用了比现代 25 年前的印刷方法制作法庭获悉，一名试图向苏富比拍卖行出售假古代雕像的欺诈者因发现他的伪造随附文件是用比现代 25 年的印刷方法书写的印刷方法而被挫败。周五，伦敦南华克皇家法院获悉，46 岁的安德鲁·克劳利 (Andrew Crowley) 要求拍卖师对他从祖父那里继承的三件基克拉迪雕像和一尊安纳托利亚观星者小雕像进行估价。继续阅读...

reflection.en: This story highlights how deception, even when meticulously planned, often contains flaws that lead to its exposure. The attempt to pass off fakes with false documentation underscores the enduring truth that dishonesty, like a false balance, ultimately cannot stand.
reflection.zh: 这个故事揭示了欺骗，即使经过精心策划，也常因破绽而最终败露。试图用虚假文件蒙混过关的行为，强调了一个持久的真理：不诚实，就像不准的秤一样，最终无法立足。

verse.textEn: Yahweh detests dishonest scales, but accurate weights find favor with him.
verse.textZh: 诡诈的天平为雅伟所憎恶；公平的法码为他所喜悦。

title.en: California: 40,000 people ordered to evacuate over chemical leak fears
title.zh: 加州：因化学品泄漏担忧，4万人被勒令撤离

summary.en: Authorities in Orange County, California, ordered the evacuation of 40,000 residents due to fears of a chemical leak from a tank holding methyl methacrylate, which was described as "actively in crisis" and threatened to spill or explode.
summary.zh: 加州橙县当局下令疏散4万居民，原因是担心一个储存甲基丙烯酸甲酯的储罐发生化学品泄漏，该储罐被描述为“处于活跃危机中”，并有溢出或爆炸的威胁。

body.en: Authorities in Orange county say tank holding methyl methacrylate ‘actively in crisis’ and urge residents to leave Authorities in Orange county, California have ordered the evacuation of 40,000 people over concerns about a chemical leak that threatened to spill or explode. The problem arose on Thursday at a facility owned by GKN Aerospace in the town of Garden Grove, where a storage tank holding methyl methacrylate began off-gassing and threatened to fail. The chemical, which is highly flammable , is used to fabricate resins and plastics. Continue reading...
body.zh: 奥兰治县当局表示，装有甲基丙烯酸甲酯的储罐“正处于危机之中”，并敦促居民离开。由于担心化学品泄漏，可能导致溢出或爆炸，加利福尼亚州奥兰治县当局已下令疏散 4 万人。周四，吉凯恩航空航天公司位于加登格罗夫镇的一家工厂出现了这一问题，该工厂的一个装有甲基丙烯酸甲酯的储罐开始放气，并有可能发生故障。这种化学品高度易燃，用于制造树脂和塑料。继续阅读...

reflection.en: When sudden dangers like a chemical leak force thousands from their homes, it highlights our vulnerability and the urgent need for safety. In such moments of crisis and uncertainty, we are reminded that true refuge and strength can be found in 雅伟, who is an ever-present help in trouble.
reflection.zh: 当化学品泄漏等突发危险迫使数千人撤离家园时，这凸显了我们的脆弱和对安全的迫切需求。在这样的危机和不确定时刻，我们被提醒，真正的避难所和力量可以在雅伟那里找到，祂是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Czechia: Uproar over Sudeten German gathering in Brno
title.zh: 捷克：苏台德德裔在布尔诺的聚会引发骚动

summary.en: The first gathering of Sudeten Germans in Czechia since World War II is set to go ahead this weekend, despite a political backlash that has exposed tensions over one of Central Europe's most painful historical legacies.
summary.zh: 第二次世界大战以来，苏台德德裔在捷克举行的首次聚会定于本周末举行，尽管遭到政治强烈反对，但此次聚会暴露了中欧最痛苦历史遗产之一的紧张关系。

body.en:
The first gathering of Sudeten Germans in Czechia since World War II is set to go ahead this weekend, despite a political backlash that has exposed tensions over one of Central Europe's most painful historical legacies.

The annual Sudetendeutscher Tag, a meeting of ethnic Germans expelled from Czechoslovakia after the World War II and their descendants, will take place in the Czech city of Brno from May 22 to 25 as part of the Meeting Brno festival of reconciliation.

But the event has triggered protests and a parliamentary declaration warning against what some Czech lawmakers called "historical revisionism" and the "relativization of Nazi crimes."

"The Chamber of Deputies expresses its opposition to the holding of the 76th convention of the Sudetendeutsche Landsmannschaft [Sudeten German Association] on the territory of the Czech Republic , in view of the historical context and the fact that attitudes questioning the postwar settlement have long appeared within parts of this movement," read the declaration passed in the lower house of the Czech parliament on Friday.

The motion, which was symbolic and non-binding, passed by 73 votes to none, with four abstentions.

Center-right opposition parties boycotted the debate, accusing the governing coalition — which includes the far-right SPD party — of exploiting the issue for political gain.

Prime Minister Andrej Babis has apparently changed his stance on the event. He recently said that the gathering in Brno is "not a fortunate development," despite having previously referred to it in neutral terms as a civic initiative that the Czech government was not dealing with.

The event has also drawn protests in Brno itself. Around 500 people joined a demonstration in April organized by the SPD.

The SPD is firmly opposed to the gathering, and accuses Sudeten German organizations of seeking to overturn the postwar Benes decrees that confiscated German property and stripped ethnic Germans of citizenship.

This accusation is rejected by Bernd Posselt, chairman of the Sudeten German Association, the main organization representing Sudeten German expellees. Posselt has stressed that the Sudeten German Association no longer seeks to challenge the postwar order and described the event as an effort at reconciliation.

In 2015, the association made some key changes to its charter , among other things removing references to reparations and the reclamation of land.

Posselt, a former lawmaker for Bavaria's conservative Christian Social Union party, told DW that the organization wanted an honest discussion of the past. He has since criticized the parliamentary declaration and insisted the gathering would go ahead.

The organizers of the Meeting Brno festival also issued a statement saying that the gathering will proceed...
body.zh: 尽管政治上的强烈反对暴露了中欧最痛苦的历史遗产之一的紧张局势，但二战以来苏台德德国人在捷克的首次集会将于本周末举行。 一年一度的“苏台德意志大会”（Sudetendeutscher Tag）是二战后被驱逐出捷克斯洛伐克的德意志人及其后裔的一次聚会，将于 5 月 22 日至 25 日在捷克布尔诺市举行，作为布尔诺和解节的一部分。 但这一事件引发了抗议活动，议会发表声明警告一些捷克议员所谓的“历史修正主义”和“纳粹罪行的相对化”。 捷克议会下院周五通过的声明中写道：“考虑到历史背景以及该运动部分地区长期以来存在质疑战后解决方案的态度，众议院表示反对在捷克共和国境内举行苏台德德国协会第76届代表大会。” 该动议具有象征性，不具约束力，以 73 票对零票、四票弃权获得通过。 中右翼反对党抵制这场辩论，指责包括极右翼社会民主党在内的执政联盟利用这一问题谋取政治利益。 总理安德烈·巴比斯显然改变了对这一事件的立场。他最近表示，布尔诺的集会“并不是一个幸运的事态发展”，尽管他之前曾用中性的措辞将其称为捷克政府没有处理的公民倡议。 该事件还引起了布尔诺本身的抗议。大约 500 人参加了社民党 4 月份组织的示威活动。 社民党坚决反对这次集会，并指责苏台德德国组织试图推翻战后没收德国财产并剥夺德国人公民身份的贝奈斯法令。 代表苏台德德国被驱逐者的主要组织苏台德德国协会主席伯恩德·波塞尔特驳斥了这一指控。波塞尔特强调，苏台德德国协会不再寻求挑战战后秩序，并将此次活动描述为和解的努力。 2015年，该协会对其章程进行了一些重大修改，其中删除了有关赔偿和开垦土地的内容。 巴伐利亚保守派基督教社会联盟党前议员波塞尔特告诉德国之声，该组织希望对过去进行诚实的讨论。此后他批评了议会的声明，并坚称集会将继续进行。 布尔诺会议节的组织者也发表声明称，聚会将继续进行……

reflection.en: The gathering of Sudeten Germans in Czechia highlights how deeply historical wounds can persist, creating "walls of hostility" between peoples even generations later. The biblical call to reconciliation reminds us that true peace involves actively dismantling these barriers, seeking understanding and healing where division once reigned. This journey...
reflection.zh: 捷克苏台德德裔的聚会凸显了历史创伤的根深蒂固，即使几代人之后，仍能在民族之间筑起“敌意的墙”。圣经中和解的呼召提醒我们，真正的和平在于积极拆除这些障碍，在曾经分裂的地方寻求理解与医治。这段旅程需要勇气去面对过去，并致力于建设共同的未来。

verse.textEn: For he himself is our peace, who has made the two groups one and has destroyed the barrier, the dividing wall of hostility.
verse.textZh: 因他使我们和睦，将两下合而为一，拆毁了中间隔断的墙。

title.en: At least 90 dead in Chinese coal mine explosion, state media reports
title.zh: 中国官方媒体报道，中国煤矿爆炸至少造成90人死亡

summary.en: An explosion occurred at a coal mine in northern China on Friday evening, resulting in the deaths of at least 90 people, according to state media reports.
summary.zh: 据中国官方媒体报道，周五晚间中国北方一煤矿发生爆炸，造成至少90人死亡。

body.en:
At least 90 people have been killed in a coal mine blast in northern China, according to the country's state media.

The gas explosion happened at the Liushenyu Coal Mine, run by the Tongzhou Group, in Shanxi Province.

Hundreds of rescuers have been sent to the site. Footage from state media showed paramedics carrying stretchers at the site, with ambulances in the background. More than 100 people are said to have been taken to hospital, with rescue work at the site still under way.

The blast happened at 19:29 local time on Friday (11:29 GMT) at a coal mine in Shanxi, with 247 workers reportedly on duty at the time of the incident.

Following the incident, Chinese President Xi Jinping called for no effort to be spared in efforts to treat the injured and search for survivors.

He also asked the government to investigate the cause of the accident and hold those responsible to account.

Officials running the coal mine have been detained, according to state media. The cause of the gas explosion has not yet been revealed, but state media reported that the levels of carbon monoxide - a highly toxic, odourless gas - in the mine were found to have "exceeded limits".

China's Ministry of Emergency Management has sent 345 personnel from six rescue teams to help with the operation.

Shanxi, one of China's poorer provinces, is known as the country's coal-mining capital.

In the early 2000s, deadly accidents were common in China's coal mining industry. Safety standards have been tightened in recent years, but accidents still occur.

In 2023, a collapse at an open-pit coal mine in the northern Inner Mongolia region killed 53 people.

Back in 2009, an explosion at a mine in Heilongjiang province in the north-east killed more than 100.

China is the world's biggest consumer of coal and the largest emitter of greenhouse gases, even as it installs renewable energy capacity at record speed.
body.zh: 据中国官方媒体报道，中国北方的煤矿爆炸已造成至少 90 人死亡。 瓦斯爆炸发生在山西省通州集团旗下的六神峪煤矿。 数百名救援人员已被派往现场。官方媒体的视频显示，医护人员在现场抬着担架，背景是救护车。据称已有100多人被送往医院，现场救援工作仍在进行中。 爆炸发生在当地时间周五 19 点 29 分（格林威治标准时间 11 点 29 分），山西一煤矿发生爆炸，据报道事发时有 247 名工人在值班。 事件发生后，中国国家主席习近平要求全力救治伤员、搜寻幸存者。 他还要求政府调查事故原因，追究相关责任人的责任。 据官方媒体报道，该煤矿的管理官员已被拘留。瓦斯爆炸的原因尚未公布，但官方媒体报道称，矿井中一氧化碳（一种剧毒、无味的气体）的含量被发现“超出了限度”。 中国应急管理部已派出6支救援队、345名人员协助救援。 山西是中国较贫困的省份之一，被称为中国的煤矿之都。 2000年代初期，中国煤矿行业死亡事故屡见不鲜。近年来，安全标准不断加强，但事故仍时有发生。 2023年，内蒙古北部地区一座露天煤矿发生塌方，造成53人死亡。 早在2009年，东北部黑龙江省的一座矿井发生爆炸，造成100多人死亡。 中国是世界上最大的煤炭消费国和最大的温室气体排放国，尽管它以创纪录的速度安装可再生能源。

reflection.en: The news of so many lives lost in this mine explosion brings profound sorrow and reminds us of the fragility of life. In moments of such deep grief, we hold onto the promise that one day, God will wipe away every tear, and there will be no more death or pain. This hope sustains us even as we mourn with those who suffer.
reflection.zh: 这起煤矿爆炸事故造成如此多生命逝去的消息，带来了深切的悲痛，也提醒我们生命的脆弱。在如此深重的悲伤时刻，我们紧紧抓住那应许：有一天，雅伟将擦去所有的眼泪，不再有死亡和痛苦。这份盼望在悲伤中支撑着我们，与受苦之人一同哀悼。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

In moments of deep grief, we hold onto the hope of a future where all tears will be wiped away, and suffering, mourning, and pain will be no more. reflection.zh: 矿井爆炸中生命的悲剧性逝去带来了深切的悲痛，提醒我们人类生命的脆弱和突如其来损失的痛苦。在深切的悲伤时刻，我们怀抱对未来的希望，那时所有的眼泪都将被擦去，不再有痛苦、悲伤和哭泣。这个应许带来慰藉，指向超越我们当前悲伤的最终复原。

verse.textEn: He will wipe every tear from their eyes. There will be no more death or mourning or crying or pain.
verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: Trump administration to end in-country applications for US permanent residency
title.zh: 特朗普政府将终止在美国境内申请美国永久居留的程序

summary.en: The Trump administration announced an end to in-country applications for US permanent residency, marking another measure to tighten legal immigration processes.
summary.zh: 特朗普政府宣布将终止在美国境内申请永久居留的程序，这是其收紧美国合法移民政策的最新举措。

body.en:
Foreigners in the US who want a green card will need to leave and apply in their home country, the Trump administration has announced, in a surprise change to a longstanding policy.

For more than half a century, foreign nationals with legal status have been able to apply for and complete the entire process for permanent residence in the United States - including individuals married to US citizens, holders of work and student visas, and refugees and political asylum seekers, among others.

The announcement from US Citizenship and Immigration Services (USCIS) said foreigners who are in America temporarily and who want to apply to become lawful permanent residents, or green card holders, have to return home and apply there, except in "extraordinary circumstances".

"Nonimmigrants, like students, temporary workers, or people on tourist visas, come to the US for a short time and for a specific purpose. Our system is designed for them to leave when their visit is over. Their visit should not function as the first step in the Green Card process," the agency said in a statement on Friday, local time.

It is the latest step by the Trump administration to make legal immigration more difficult for foreigners already in the US and for those hoping to come here.

Doug Rand, a former senior advisor at USCIS during the Biden administration, said the goal of the policy change was "very explicit".

"Senior officials in this administration have said over and over that they want fewer people to get permanent residency because permanent residency is a path to citizenship, and they want to block that path for as many people as possible," he said.

Rand said about 600,000 people already in the US apply each year for a green card.

USCIS did not say when the change would come into effect, whether individuals would be required to remain in another country throughout the entire process, or whether the policy impacts foreigners whose green card applications are already underway.

In an emailed statement to the Associated Press, the agency said people who provide an "economic benefit" or "national interest" could likely stay in the US, while others would have to go abroad to apply.

The changes come on top of steps the administration has already taken to restrict and limit entry for people from dozens of countries.

USCIS described the change as a return to "the original intent of the law" and closing a "loophole".

But immigration lawyers and aid groups pushed back, saying it was longstanding practice for many groups to be able to adjust their status in the US.

"USCIS is trying to upend decades of processing of adjustment of status," said Shev Dalal-Dheini from the American Immigration Lawyers Association.

Among those affected could be individuals married to US citizens,...
body.zh: 特朗普政府宣布，在美国想要绿卡的外国人需要离开并在自己的祖国申请，这是对一项长期政策的意外改变。 半个多世纪以来，拥有合法身份的外国人一直能够申请并完成在美国永久居留的整个流程，其中包括与美国公民结婚的个人、工作和学生签证持有者、难民和政治庇护寻求者等。 美国公民及移民服务局（USCIS）的公告称，临时在美国并想申请成为合法永久居民或绿卡持有者的外国人必须回国并在美国申请，除非“特殊情况”。 该机构在当地时间周五的一份声明中表示：“非移民，如学生、临时工或持旅游签证的人，是为了特定目的而短暂来到美国的。我们的系统是为他们在访问结束后离开而设计的。他们的访问不应作为绿卡流程的第一步。” 这是特朗普政府采取的最新举措，目的是让已经在美国和希望来到美国的外国人的合法移民变得更加困难。 拜登政府时期美国移民局前高级顾问道格·兰德表示，政策改变的目标“非常明确”。 他说：“本届政府的高级官员一再表示，他们希望更少的人获得永久居留权，因为永久居留权是获得公民身份的一条途径，他们希望尽可能多的人阻止这条道路。” 兰德表示，每年约有 60 万人在美国申请绿卡。 美国移民局没有透露这一变化何时生效，是否会要求个人在整个过程中留在另一个国家，或者该政策是否会影响已经在进行绿卡申请的外国人。 该机构在发给美联社的电子邮件声明中表示，提供“经济利益”或“国家利益”的人可能会留在美国，而其他人则必须出国申请。 在这些变化之前，政府已经采取了限制来自数十个国家的人员入境的措施。 美国移民局将这一变化描述为回归“法律的初衷”并弥补“漏洞”。 但移民律师和援助团体反驳说，许多团体能够调整自己在美国的身份是长期以来的做法。 美国移民律师协会的谢夫·达拉尔·戴尼 (Shev Dalal-Dheini) 表示：“美国移民局正试图颠覆数十年来的身份调整流程。” 受影响的人可能包括与美国公民结婚的个人，...

reflection.en: This policy change impacts individuals seeking to establish a new life and find belonging. The ancient call to treat foreigners as native-born reminds us of the human dignity and shared experience of those seeking a home, urging compassion in how nations manage migration.
reflection.zh: 这项政策变化影响着寻求新生活并找到归属感的个体。古老的呼召，要将寄居者视如本地人，提醒我们那些寻求家园之人的人性尊严和共同经历，敦促各国在管理移民时展现怜悯。

title.en: Rubio visits India to sell energy as Iran oil shock persists
title.zh: 鲁比奥访问印度推销能源，伊朗石油冲击持续

summary.en: A senior US diplomat has visited India, offering to meet the nation's energy needs amidst ongoing disruptions from Iran oil sanctions. The visit raises questions about India's strategic choices regarding its energy supply.
summary.zh: 一位美国高级外交官访问印度，表示愿意满足该国在伊朗石油制裁持续影响下的能源需求。此次访问引发了印度对其能源供应战略选择的讨论。

body.en:
US Secretary of State Marco Rubio arrived in India on Saturday for a four-day visit amid geopolitical crosswinds and a global energy crisis triggered by the Iran war.

He arrived in the eastern city of Kolkata (formerly Calcutta) in the morning local time. His busy itinerary also includes visits to Delhi, Jaipur and Agra.

He is also due to meet Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, with energy likely to be high on the agenda.

Energy shipments through the Strait of Hormuz - a narrow waterway that has become a flashpoint since Israel and the US attacked Iran in February - have virtually ground to a halt.

Iran has used the closure of the strait as a pressure tactic in the fragile peace negotiations with the US.

India, which imports more than 80% of its energy needs, is one of the worst-affected countries as its vast population of more than 1.4 billion depends on overseas fuel supply, including cooking gas and petroleum products, to sustain daily life.

Rubio has already acknowledged the challenges facing Asia's third-largest economy.

"We want to sell them [India] as much energy as they'll buy. And obviously, you've seen, I think, we're at historic levels of US production and US export," he said.

There will be appetite in Delhi to boost its energy imports from the US as it will also help bridge the trade deficit that has been in India's favour - something that has constantly irked US President Donald Trump.

The US goods trade deficit with India was $58.2bn (£43.3bn) in 2025, a 27.1% increase on 2024.

But it's not a straightforward solution. It's a much longer and expensive route for India to get energy shipments from the US.

And analysts say it is not logical for India to fill the current shortfall in its imports from the US.

"Energy security is going to be the key theme of this visit because the Iran situation is not going to be resolved anytime soon," Vineet Prakash, associate professor of US studies at Delhi's Jawaharlal Nehru University, said.

"The US has already given a waiver to India on buying Russian oil, but Delhi is likely to push for more concessions."

Rubio's visit also comes under the shadow of prolonged tensions between Delhi and Washington over trade negotiations and conflicting claims on who settled the brief India-Pakistan conflict last year.

While Trump has repeatedly claimed that he brokered peace between the neighbours, Delhi has consistently denied this with its stated policy of not welcoming a third party to mediate between the nuclear-armed nations in South Asia.

What also appears to have displeased Delhi is Trump's open affection for Pakistani army chief Asim Munir, whom the US president has called his "favourite field marshal".

body.zh: 在地缘政治逆风和伊朗战争引发的全球能源危机之际，美国国务卿卢比奥周六抵达印度开始为期四天的访问。 他于当地时间上午抵达东部城市加尔各答（原加尔各答）。他繁忙的行程还包括访问德里、斋浦尔和阿格拉。 他还将与印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪会面，能源问题可能是议程的重点。 自以色列和美国二月份袭击伊朗以来，霍尔木兹海峡的能源运输几乎已陷入停滞。霍尔木兹海峡是一条狭窄的航道，已成为热点。 伊朗利用关闭海峡作为与美国脆弱的和平谈判的施压策略。 印度80%以上的能源需求依赖进口，是受影响最严重的国家之一，因为该国超过14亿的庞大人口依赖海外燃料供应（包括烹饪燃气和石油产品）来维持日常生活。 卢比奥已经承认亚洲第三大经济体面临的挑战。 “我们希望向他们（印度）出售尽可能多的能源。显然，我认为你已经看到，我们的美国生产和出口处于历史水平，”他说。 新德里将有兴趣增加从美国的能源进口，因为这也将有助于弥补一直对印度有利的贸易逆差——而这一直令唐纳德·特朗普总统感到恼火。 2025年美国对印度的货物贸易逆差为582亿美元，比2024年增加27.1%。 但这不是一个简单的解决方案。对于印度来说，从美国获得能源运输的路线更长且成本更高。 分析人士表示，印度填补目前从美国进口的缺口是不合逻辑的。 德里贾瓦哈拉尔尼赫鲁大学美国研究副教授维尼特·普拉卡什表示：“能源安全将成为此次访问的主题，因为伊朗问题不会很快得到解决。美国已经对印度购买俄罗斯石油给予豁免，但德里可能会争取更多让步。” 卢比奥的访问还受到德里和华盛顿之间因贸易谈判而长期紧张的阴影，以及去年谁解决了短暂的印巴冲突的相互矛盾的说法的影响。 尽管特朗普一再声称他在邻国之间斡旋了和平，但德里一直否认这一点，并以其不欢迎第三方在南亚核武国家之间进行调解的既定政策。 似乎也让德里不高兴的是特朗普对巴基斯坦陆军参谋长阿西姆·穆尼尔的公开感情，美国总统称他为“最喜欢的陆军元帅”。 巴基斯坦在伊朗和美国之间的和平调解努力似乎给伊斯兰堡带来了......

reflection.en: Nations, like individuals, face complex decisions that require careful deliberation and wise counsel. As India navigates its energy future amid geopolitical shifts, the need for sound guidance is paramount for the well-being and stability of its people.
reflection.zh: 国家和个人一样，面临着需要深思熟虑和明智建议的复杂决策。在印度应对地缘政治变化中的能源未来时，为人民的福祉和稳定寻求健全的指导至关重要。

title.en: SpaceX launches biggest model of Starship megarocket
title.zh: SpaceX发射最大型号星舰巨型火箭

summary.en: SpaceX has launched its biggest Starship yet as the company races against Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin for space exploration dominance.
summary.zh: SpaceX已成功发射其迄今为止最大的星舰火箭，这加剧了其与杰夫·贝佐斯旗下蓝色起源公司在太空探索领域主导地位的竞争。

body.en:
SpaceX has launched its biggest, most powerful Starship yet on a test flight, an upgraded version that NASA is counting on to land astronauts on the moon.

The redesigned mega rocket made its debut two days after SpaceX chief Elon Musk announced he's taking the company public in a potentially record initial public offering.

The rocket blasted off from the southern tip of Texas, carrying 20 mock Starlink satellites for release halfway around the world.

The mammoth rocket blasted off into space at just after 5.30 pm local time. It completed the test before splashing down into the Indian Ocean on Friday.

It's the 12th test flight of the rocket that Musk is building to get people to Mars one day. But first comes the moon and NASA's Artemis program.

The last of the old space-skimming Starships lifted off in October. SpaceX's third-generation Starship — a souped-up version dubbed V3 — soared from a brand-new launch pad at Starbase, near the Mexican border.

SpaceX was hoping to avoid the fireworks it experienced during back-to-back launches in 2025 when midair explosions rained wreckage down on the Atlantic. Earlier flights also ended in flames.

At 124 metres, the latest model eclipses the older Starship lines by more than a metre and packs more engine thrust.

The revamped booster sports fewer but bigger and stronger grid fins for steering it back to earth following liftoff, and a larger and more robust fuel transfer line to feed the 33 main engines.

The retro-looking, stainless steel spacecraft also has more of everything — more cameras and more navigation and computer power — as well as docking cones for future rendezvous and moon missions.

Starship is meant to be fully reusable, with giant mechanical arms at the launch pads to catch the returning rocket stages. But on this latest trial run, nothing was being recovered.

NASA is paying SpaceX — and Jeff Bezos' Blue Origin — billions of dollars to provide the lunar landers that will be used to land Artemis astronauts on the moon.

While Starship has reached the fringes of space on multiple flights lasting an hour at most, Bezos' Blue Moon has yet to lift off, although a prototype is being readied for a moonshot later in 2026.

NASA is following April's successful lunar flyaround by four astronauts with a docking trial run in orbit around earth planned for 2027.

For that Artemis III mission, astronauts will practice docking their Orion capsule with Starship, Blue Moon or both.

A moon landing by two astronauts — Artemis IV— could follow as soon as 2028 using either Starship or Blue Moon, whichever lander is safer and ready first.

body.zh: SpaceX 已经在试飞中发射了迄今为止最大、最强大的星际飞船，这是 NASA 指望将宇航员送上月球的升级版本。 两天前，SpaceX 首席执行官埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 宣布，他将让该公司以可能创纪录的首次公开募股 (IPO) 方式上市，两天后，这款重新设计的巨型火箭首次亮相。 这艘火箭从德克萨斯州南端发射升空，运载着 20 颗模拟星链卫星，将发射到半个地球。 当地时间下午 5 点 30 分刚过，这艘巨大的火箭发射升空。它在周五溅入印度洋之前完成了测试。 这是马斯克正在建造的火箭的第 12 次试飞，目的是有一天将人们送上火星。但首先是月球和美国宇航局的阿尔忒弥斯计划。 最后一艘老式掠空星舰于十月升空。 SpaceX 的第三代星际飞船——一个名为 V3 的增强版——从靠近墨西哥边境的 Starbase 的全新发射台升空。 SpaceX 希望避免 2025 年连续发射时发生的烟火事件，当时空中爆炸将残骸如雨点般落到大西洋上。早些时候的航班也因火灾而结束。 最新型号的高度为 124 米，比旧款 Starship 系列高出一米多，并且发动机推力更大。 改进后的助推器配备了更少但更大、更强的网格翅片，用于在升空后将其引导回地面，以及更大、更坚固的燃油传输管线，为 33 个主发动机提供燃料。 这艘外观复古的不锈钢航天器还拥有更多的东西——更多的摄像头、更多的导航和计算机能力——以及用于未来交会和月球任务的对接锥体。 星舰应该是完全可重复使用的，发射台上有巨大的机械臂来捕捉返回的火箭级。但在最近的这次试运行中，没有任何恢复。 NASA 正在向 SpaceX 和杰夫·贝佐斯的蓝色起源公司支付数十亿美元，以提供用于将阿耳忒弥斯宇航员送上月球的月球着陆器。 虽然 Starship 已经通过最多持续一小时的多次飞行到达太空边缘，但贝索斯的蓝月亮尚未升空，尽管原型机已准备好在 2026 年晚些时候进行登月。 继 4 月份四名宇航员成功绕月飞行之后，美国宇航局 (NASA) 计划于 2027 年在绕地轨道上进行对接试运行。 在阿耳忒弥斯三号任务中，宇航员将练习将猎户座太空舱与星舰、蓝月亮或两者对接。 两名宇航员——阿耳忒弥斯四号——最早可能于 2028 年使用“星际飞船”或“蓝月亮”登陆月球，以更安全且先准备好的着陆器为准。 这将是美国宇航局自 1972 年阿波罗 17 号以来首次载人登月。这次的目标是......

reflection.en: As humanity launches ever-larger rockets into the cosmos, we are reminded of our unique place in creation. Psalm 8:4-6 reflects on the wonder of human beings, made with dignity and entrusted with stewardship over the works of God's hands. This drive to explore the vastness beyond Earth can be seen as an expression of that inherent human capacity and calling.
reflection.zh: 当人类将越来越大的火箭送入宇宙时，我们被提醒自己在创造中的独特地位。诗篇8:4-6反思了人类的奇妙，我们被赋予尊严，并受托管理雅伟手所造之物。这种探索地球之外广阔宇宙的动力，可以被视为人类固有的能力和呼召的一种体现。

title.en: Tulsi Gabbard resigns as top US intelligence official
title.zh: 图尔西·加巴德辞去美国高级情报官员职务

summary.en: Tulsi Gabbard, the first Hindu member at the White House, has resigned from her position as a top US intelligence official. She is widely recognized for her consistent opposition to foreign wars.
summary.zh: 作为白宫首位印度教成员，图尔西·加巴德已辞去美国高级情报官员的职务。她以反对对外战争而闻名。

body.en:
Tulsi Gabbard will resign as the United States director of national intelligence, saying she has to step away as her husband battles cancer.

Her husband had been diagnosed ‌with a rare form of bone cancer, and she is leaving her role to help him.

Gabbard advised US President Donald Trump of her intention to step down during a meeting at the White House on Friday, with the resignation effective 30 June, according to Fox News Digital.

In her resignation letter posted on X, Gabbard told Trump she was "deeply grateful for the trust you placed in me and for the opportunity to lead the Office of the Director of National Intelligence for the last year and a half".

She cited ⁠her husband's recent diagnosis with ‌a rare form of bone cancer.

"I cannot in good conscience ask him to face this fight alone while ‌I continue in this demanding and time-consuming post," she said.

However, a source familiar with ‌the matter told Reuters that Gabbard ⁠had been forced out by the White House.

In a post on his Truth Social platform, Trump said the principal deputy director of national intelligence, Aaron Lukas, would serve as acting director of national intelligence.

He said Gabbard had done "an incredible job" but with her husband diagnosed with ‌bone cancer, "she, rightfully, wants to be with him, bringing him back to good health as they currently fight a tough battle together".

Trump has hinted in the past at differences with Gabbard on their approach to Iran, saying in March that she was "softer" than him on curbing Iran's nuclear ambitions.

Gabbard, a veteran and former Democratic congresswoman from Hawaii, built her political name on her opposition to foreign wars.

This put her in an awkward position when the US joined Israel in launching attacks on Iran on 28 February.

During a congressional hearing in March, her measured comments were notable for their careful non-endorsement of the decision to strike Iran.

She dodged questions about whether the White House had been warned of potential fallout from the conflict, including Iran's effective closure of the Strait of Hormuz.

"It is not the intelligence community's responsibility to determine what is and is not an imminent threat," she said.

Gabbard ran for president in 2020 on a progressive platform and her opposition to US involvement in foreign military conflicts.

Citing her military experience, she argued that wars in the Middle East had destabilised the region, made the US less safe and cost thousands of lives.

Gabbard later dropped out of the race and endorsed the ultimate winner, Joe Biden.

Two years later, she left the Democratic party to become an independent, saying her old party was dominated by an "elitist cabal of warmongers" and "woke"...
body.zh: 图尔西·加巴德将辞去美国国家情报总监一职，称由于丈夫与癌症作斗争，她必须辞职。 她的丈夫被诊断出患有一种罕见的骨癌，她将辞去职务来帮助他。 据福克斯新闻数字报道，加巴德在周五的白宫会议上向美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表示她打算辞职，辞职于 6 月 30 日生效。 在 X 上发布的辞职信中，加巴德告诉特朗普，她“非常感谢您对我的信任，以及在过去一年半里有机会领导国家情报总监办公室”。 她引用了她丈夫最近被诊断出患有一种罕见骨癌的例子。 她说：“凭良心来说，我不能要求他独自面对这场战斗，而我则继续担任这个要求很高且耗时的职位。” 然而，一位知情人士告诉路透社，加巴德是被白宫逼出来的。 特朗普在其“真相社交”平台上发帖称，国家情报局首席副局长亚伦·卢卡斯将担任代理国家情报局局长。 他说加巴德做了“一项令人难以置信的工作”，但由于她的丈夫被诊断出患有骨癌，“她理所当然地想和他在一起，让他恢复健康，因为他们目前正在共同进行一场艰苦的战斗”。 特朗普过去曾暗示与加巴德在处理伊朗问题上存在分歧，并在三月份表示，她在遏制伊朗核野心方面比他“软弱”。 加巴德是一位来自夏威夷的退伍军人、前民主党女议员，她因反对对外战争而声名鹊起。 当美国2月28日与以色列一起对伊朗发动袭击时，这让她处于尴尬的境地。 在三月份的国会听证会上，她谨慎的评论因谨慎地不支持打击伊朗的决定而引人注目。 她回避了有关白宫是否已收到有关冲突潜在后果的警告的问题，其中包括伊朗有效关闭霍尔木兹海峡。 “情报界没有责任确定什么是迫在眉睫的威胁，什么不是迫在眉睫的威胁，”她说。 加巴德以进步纲领和反对美国卷入外国军事冲突的立场竞选 2020 年总统。 她援引自己的军事经验，认为中东战争破坏了该地区的稳定，使美国变得更加不安全，并造成数千人丧生。 加巴德后来退出竞选并支持最终获胜者乔·拜登。 两年后，她离开民主党成为独立党，称她的旧党由“战争贩子精英集团”主导，并“觉醒”了……

reflection.en: Public service often presents complex moral choices, especially in matters of war and peace. Micah 6:8 reminds us that what is truly good involves doing justice, loving kindness, and walking humbly with God. This principle can guide leaders as they navigate their roles, seeking to align their actions with a deep sense of moral integrity.
reflection.zh: 公共服务常涉及复杂的道德抉择，尤其是在战争与和平的问题上。弥迦书6:8提醒我们，真正的良善在于行公义，好怜悯，并谦卑地与雅伟同行。这一原则能指引领袖们在履行职责时，努力使自己的行动与深刻的道德正直感保持一致。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: New alliances emerge in Middle East — which one will 'win'?
title.zh: 中东地区新联盟涌现——谁将‘获胜’？

summary.en: New alliances are forming in the Middle East, with the UAE and Israel strengthening ties, while Saudi Arabia enhances cooperation with Egypt, Turkey, and Pakistan. These developments highlight a growing rift in the Gulf region due to differing approaches to the Iran war and other regional issues.
summary.zh: 中东地区正在形成新的联盟，阿联酋和以色列的关系日益密切，而沙特阿拉伯则加强了与埃及、土耳其和巴基斯坦的合作。这些新联盟反映了海湾地区因对伊朗战争和地区问题的不同看法而产生的裂痕。

body.en:
The UAE and Israel are getting closer, while Saudi Arabia is enhancing cooperation with Egypt, Turkey and Pakistan. The new alliances represent a rift in the Gulf, as approaches to the Iran war and the region diverge.

To all appearances, it really looks as if the United Arab Emirates  has picked a side as a result of the US and Israel's  war with Iran , a side that could isolate it from much of the rest of the Arab world.

Earlier this week, it was reported that Israel and the UAE were establishing a joint defense fund, which would see the two countries buying weapons together. The report, first published by the media outlet Middle East Eye , cited two unnamed US officials and has not been confirmed by either government.

The fund was apparently agreed to during a secret visit Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu made to the UAE, which he made public on the evening of May 13. A few hours later, the UAE denied the visit ever happened.

The day before, at an event in Tel Aviv, US Ambassador to Israel Mike Huckabee confirmed that Israel had loaned the UAE aerial defense weaponry in order to help defend against air attacks from Iran. 

All that — combined with the UAE's late-April announcement that it was leaving the oil producers' syndicate OPEC , to which it had belonged for 59 years — caused a rash of analyses stating that the Middle East was changing radically.

"A decades-old Gulf order is fading, and another is taking shape," Cinzia Bianco, a visiting fellow at the European Council on Foreign Relations, wrote in a mid-May commentary .

"The geopolitical earthquake sparked by the UAE is more than a temporary regional conflict," Ma Young-sam, a former Korean ambassador to Israel, recently said in the English-language daily  The Korea Times . "It signals the emergence of a new Middle Eastern order."

Marcus Schneider, who heads the Friedrich Ebert Foundation's regional project for peace and security in the Middle East in Lebanon, described the two emerging blocs like this: One is a hexagon, he said, made up of the UAE and Israel, and the second is a diamond shape, consisting of Saudi Arabia , Pakistan , Turkey and Egypt . The latter countries, which have Sunni-majority populations, have also been called "the Quartet."

Schneider said what connects Israel and the UAE is that both are currently practicing policies of "disruption" to try to "reshape the Middle East and beyond."

Netanyahu has frequently boasted that Israel is "changing the face of the Middle East," something he repeated in early March  after Israel's joint attack on Iran with the US. The UAE also "seeks to redraw the map of the Middle East and build new networks of geopolitical and geoeconomic...
body.zh: 阿联酋和以色列关系日益密切，沙特则加强与埃及、土耳其和巴基斯坦的合作。随着伊朗战争和该地区的态度出现分歧，新的联盟代表了海湾地区的裂痕。 从表面上看，由于美国和以色列与伊朗的战争，阿拉伯联合酋长国确实已经选择了一边，这一边可能会将其与阿拉伯世界的其他大部分地区隔离。 本周早些时候，有报道称以色列和阿联酋正在建立联合防务基金，两国将共同购买武器。这份由媒体《中东之眼》首先发表的报告援引了两名未透露姓名的美国官员的话，但尚未得到两国政府的证实。 该基金显然是在以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡对阿联酋进行秘密访问期间同意的，他于 5 月 13 日晚将访问公开。几个小时后，阿联酋否认曾进行过这次访问。 前一天，在特拉维夫举行的一次活动中，美国驻以色列大使迈克·哈卡比证实，以色列已向阿联酋借出防空武器，以帮助抵御伊朗的空袭。 所有这一切，加上阿联酋 4 月底宣布退出已加入该组织 59 年的石油生产国欧佩克 (OPEC)，引发了大量分析，认为中东正在发生根本性变化。 欧洲外交关系委员会客座研究员辛齐亚·比安科 (Cinzia Bianco) 在 5 月中旬的评论中写道：“已有数十年历史的海湾秩序正在衰落，另一种秩序正在形成。” “阿联酋引发的地缘政治地震不仅仅是暂时的地区冲突，”前韩国驻以色列大使马泳三最近在英文日报《韩国时报》上表示。 “这标志着中东新秩序的出现。” 弗里德里希·艾伯特基金会黎巴嫩中东和平与安全区域项目负责人马库斯·施奈德这样描述这两个新兴集团：他说，一个是六边形，由阿联酋和以色列组成，第二个是菱形，由沙特阿拉伯、巴基斯坦、土耳其和埃及组成。后者的人口以逊尼派为主，也被称为“四方”。 施奈德表示，以色列和阿联酋的共同之处在于，两国目前都在实行“颠覆”政策，试图“重塑中东及其他地区”。 内塔尼亚胡经常吹嘘以色列正在“改变中东的面貌”，三月初，在以色列与美国联合攻击伊朗后，他又重复了这一点。 阿联酋还“寻求重新绘制中东地图并建立新的地缘政治和地缘经济网络......

reflection.en: The emergence of new alliances and deepening rifts in the Middle East highlights the constant challenge of maintaining peace amidst diverging interests. Romans 12:18 calls us to live at peace with everyone, as far as it depends on us, even when geopolitical landscapes shift. This reminds us that while nations navigate complex relationships, the pursuit of...
reflection.zh: 中东地区新联盟的出现和裂痕的加深，凸显了在利益分歧中维持和平的持续挑战。罗马书12:18呼吁我们，若是可能，总要尽力与众人和睦。这提醒我们，尽管国家在复杂的国际关系中周旋，追求和谐仍然是人类和属灵的深刻愿望。

title.en: US or Iran: Who will win the Hormuz endurance game?
title.zh: 美国还是伊朗：谁将赢得霍尔木兹耐力赛？

summary.en: Tehran is betting that its sanctions-hardened economy can outlast the Strait of Hormuz crisis. Washington, meanwhile, is contending with elevated oil prices, renewed inflation pressure and rising global recession risks.
summary.zh: 德黑兰认为，其经受制裁磨砺的经济能够比美国更持久地应对霍尔木兹海峡危机。然而，华盛顿正面临油价上涨、通胀压力重燃以及全球经济衰退风险加剧等挑战。

body.en:
Tehran is betting that its sanctions‑hardened economy can outlast the Strait of Hormuz crisis. Washington, meanwhile, is contending with elevated oil prices, renewed inflation pressure and rising global recession risks.

Deadlocked, dysfunctional and dangerous: That is how the Strait of Hormuz standoff is increasingly being described.

Now approaching its fourth month, the crisis off the coast of  Iran  is marked by mutual blockades. Tehran has been charging ships up to $2 million (€1.73 million) for safe passage through the strait, while the United States has imposed a naval embargo, turning back vessels carrying Iranian oil exports.

These competing blockades have failed to deliver decisive results. Some Iranian ships continue to slip through, while several Asian shipping firms have agreed to pay tolls, despite such fees violating international maritime law.

Fragile negotiations between the US and Iran to reopen Hormuz have, meanwhile, stalled several times, sparking the risk of escalation into a wider regional conflict.

Despite Pakistan-led mediation efforts and a proposed one-page memorandum aimed at ending hostilities and reopening Hormuz, neither side appears ready to blink first.

Dania Thafer, executive director of the Washington-based think tank Gulf International Forum, believes US President Donald Trump's on-off military threats — intended to increase its leverage over Iran — may have backfired.

"The Iranian response suggests the opposite," she told DW. "They interpret it as the US lacking the will to escalate the war."

Trump  faces increasing pressure both at home and abroad to avoid further military action, with Gulf allies such as Saudi Arabia , the United Arab Emirates  and Qatar urging restraint. Surging oil prices and rising domestic inflation are adding political heat ahead of the US midterm elections in November.

Iran, meanwhile, is losing some $435 million (about €375 million) per day in trade, nearly two-thirds of which comes from exports of mainly crude oil, Miad Maleki, a senior fellow at the conservative Washington-based Foundation for Defense of Democracies, estimated in April.

This means that with the US blockade stretching to 39 days on Friday, Iran's public finances have already suffered an estimated $17 billion loss. According to Maleki, this is in addition to around $144 billion in economic damage caused by US-Israeli strikes in the first weeks of the war.

body.zh: 德黑兰押注其遭受制裁的经济能够熬过霍尔木兹海峡危机。与此同时，华盛顿正在应对油价上涨、通胀压力再度上升以及全球衰退风险上升的问题。 僵局、功能障碍和危险：人们越来越多地这样描述霍尔木兹海峡的对峙。 伊朗沿海危机现已进入第四个月，其特点是相互封锁。 德黑兰一直向安全通过该海峡的船只收取高达 200 万美元（173 万欧元）的费用，而美国则实施了海上禁运，拒绝运载伊朗石油出口的船只。 这些相互竞争的封锁未能带来决定性的结果。一些伊朗船只继续溜过，而几家亚洲航运公司已同意支付通行费，尽管此类费用违反了国际海事法。 与此同时，美国和伊朗之间关于重新开放霍尔木兹海峡的脆弱谈判多次陷入僵局，引发了升级为更广泛地区冲突的风险。 尽管巴基斯坦主导了调解努力，并提出了一份旨在结束敌对行动并重新开放霍尔木兹的一页备忘录，但双方似乎都没有准备好先眨眼。 总部位于华盛顿的智库海湾国际论坛执行董事达尼亚·塞弗 (Dania Thafer) 认为，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普时断时续的军事威胁——旨在增加对伊朗的影响力——可能会适得其反。 “伊朗的反应表明了相反的情况，”她告诉德国之声。 “他们将此解读为美国缺乏升级战争的意愿。” 特朗普在国内外面临越来越大的压力，要求避免采取进一步的军事行动，沙特阿拉伯、阿拉伯联合酋长国和卡塔尔等海湾盟友敦促克制。在 11 月份美国中期选举之前，油价飙升和国内通胀上升加剧了政治热度。 与此同时，华盛顿保守派捍卫民主基金会高级研究员米亚德·马勒基 (Miad Maleki) 在 4 月份估计，伊朗每天的贸易损失约为 4.35 亿美元（约合 3.75 亿欧元），其中近三分之二主要来自原油出口。 这意味着，随着周五美国的封锁延长至39天，伊朗的公共财政已经遭受了估计170亿美元的损失。马莱基表示，这还不包括战争头几周美以袭击造成的约 1,440 亿美元的经济损失。 总部位于伦敦的皇家联合军种研究所的高级研究员布尔库·奥兹塞利克认为，伊朗可能通过对航运和海湾邻国的导弹袭击获得了“巨大的影响力”，但是……

Habakkuk's ancient words remind us that true resilience is found not just in material abundance, but in a deeper trust that can sustain hope even when resources are scarce and the future is unclear. This perspective...
reflection.zh: 在霍尔木兹海峡这样的地缘政治“耐力赛”中，国家常面临巨大的经济压力和不确定性。哈巴谷书的古老话语提醒我们，真正的韧性不仅在于物质的丰裕，更在于一种更深的信靠，即使资源匮乏、前途未卜，也能维系希望。这种视角鼓励我们在超越眼前境况中寻求持久的力量。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: South Africa xenophobia response under fire
title.zh: 南非仇外反应受抨击

summary.en: South Africa faces criticism for its handling of xenophobic violence. While the government condemns such acts, critics argue that prevention efforts are insufficient, arrests are rare, and political rhetoric sometimes exacerbates tensions rather than alleviating them.
summary.zh: 南非因其处理仇外暴力的方式而受到批评。尽管政府谴责此类行为，但批评人士认为，预防工作不足，逮捕人数有限，而且政治言论有时非但没有缓解反而加剧了紧张局势。

body.en:
South Africa condemns xenophobic violence when it erupts, but critics say prevention is weak, arrests are limited and political rhetoric sometimes fuels tensions instead of easing them.

As anti-foreigner tensions resurface in parts of South Africa , critics are questioning whether the government's response to xenophobia is working.

South Africa has faced repeated outbreaks of violence targeting migrants from Zimbabwe, Nigeria, Somalia, Ethiopia, Malawi, Mozambique, Ghana and Zambia.

Easlier this month, Nigeria summoned South Africa's acting high commissioner , citing growing anti-African migrant protests.

More than 60 people were killed in anti-immigrant riots in 2008, while similar unrest resurfaced in 2015 and 2016. Armed mobs attacked foreign-owned businesses around the city of Johannesburg in 2019, leaving at least 12 people dead — ten of them South African citizens.

The violence is often linked to frustrations over unemployment, crime, overcrowded services and poor living conditions — grievances that are frequently redirected toward migrants.

However, Loren Landau, a senior migration researcher at University of the Witwatersrand's (Wits) African Centre for Migration and Society in Johannesburg, argued that the roots run deeper.

"The scapegoating and demonization of migrants merely draw people's attention away from the true source of South Africa's problems and erodes democracy while putting the welfare of many people — both our own citizens and foreigners — at risk," Landau said in an article published by Wits.

"Migrants are not the source of any of South Africa's challenges. There are too few to make a substantial impact on employment or crime," Landau added.

South Africa's government says it condemns violence against foreign nationals and is working to strengthen social cohesion and migration management.

South Africa's Foreign Minister, Ronald Lamola, recently warned against civilians taking immigration enforcement into their own hands.

"It is not the responsibility of civilians to enforce the law," Lamola told DW. "Where people are told, 'You are not South African, you must go home,' that is xenophobia."

Lamola rejected claims that targeting migrants would solve South Africa's economic problems.

"The economic challenges and unemployment issues will not be resolved by chasing anyone," Lamola said. "This is not just a security issue, it is an economic and social issue."

Minister in the Presidency, Khumbudzo Ntshavheni, also defended government efforts while condemning vigilantism.

"We cannot allow anyone who is not law enforcement to demand people's passports," she told DW.

Groups such as Operation Dudula , which campaigns against undocumented migration, have become increasingly influential in public debate.

body.zh: 南非在仇外暴力爆发时予以谴责，但批评人士表示，预防措施薄弱，逮捕人数有限，政治言论有时会加剧而不是缓解紧张局势。 随着南非部分地区排外紧张局势重新出现，批评者质疑政府应对仇外心理的措施是否有效。 南非多次面临针对津巴布韦、尼日利亚、索马里、埃塞俄比亚、马拉维、莫桑比克、加纳和赞比亚移民的暴力事件。 本月早些时候，尼日利亚以反非洲移民抗议活动日益增多为由，召见了南非代理高级专员。 2008 年，反移民骚乱造成 60 多人死亡，2015 年和 2016 年再次出现类似骚乱。2019 年，武装暴徒袭击了约翰内斯堡市周围的外资企业，造成至少 12 人死亡，其中 10 人是南非公民。 暴力往往与失业、犯罪、服务过度拥挤和生活条件恶劣等不满情绪有关，而这些不满情绪往往会指向移民。 然而，位于约翰内斯堡的威特沃特斯兰德大学非洲移民与社会中心的高级移民研究员洛伦·兰道（Loren Landau）认为，根源更为深刻。 兰道在《Wits》发表的一篇文章中表示：“对移民的替罪羊和妖魔化只会让人们的注意力从南非问题的真正根源上转移开，并侵蚀民主，同时使许多人——包括我们自己的公民和外国人——的福祉面临风险。” “移民不是南非任何挑战的根源。移民数量太少，无法对就业或犯罪产生重大影响，”兰道补充道。 南非政府表示谴责针对外国人的暴力行为，并正在努力加强社会凝聚力和移民管理。 南非外交部长罗纳德·拉莫拉最近警告平民不要自行负责移民执法。 拉莫拉告诉德国之声：“执行法律不是平民的责任。” “人们被告知，‘你不是南非人，你必须回家’，这就是仇外心理。” 拉莫拉否认针对移民可以解决南非经济问题的说法。 拉莫拉说：“经济挑战和失业问题不会通过追逐任何人来解决。” “这不仅仅是一个安全问题，更是一个经济和社会问题。” 总统府部长昆布佐·恩沙夫尼 (Khumbudzo Ntshavheni) 也为政府的努力辩护，同时谴责私刑活动。 她告诉德国之声：“我们不能允许任何非执法人员索要人们的护照。” 杜杜拉行动（Operation Dudula）等反对无证移民的团体在公共辩论中的影响力越来越大。 支持者...

reflection.en: The recurring challenge of xenophobic violence reminds us of the biblical call to treat foreigners with the same dignity and love we extend to ourselves. When societies struggle with hostility towards those from other lands, it highlights a fundamental test of compassion and justice for all.
reflection.zh: 仇外暴力反复出现，提醒我们圣经中关于以对待自己同样的尊严和爱来对待外国人的呼召。当社会难以消除对异乡人的敌意时，这凸显了对所有人而言，怜悯和公义所面临的根本考验。

verse.textEn: When a foreigner resides among you in your land, do not mistreat them. The foreigner residing among you must be treated as your native-born. Love them as yourself, for you were foreigners in Egypt.
verse.textZh: 若有外人在你们国中和你同居，就不可欺负他。和你们同居的外人，你们要看他如本地人一样，并要爱他如己，因为你们在埃及地也作过寄居的。

title.en: Second IS-linked group attempting return faces 'same consequences', Plibersek says
title.zh: 普利伯塞克表示，第二批与“伊斯兰国”有关联的返澳人员将面临“同样的后果”

summary.en: Australian officials state that a second group of individuals linked to the Islamic State group, who are attempting to return to Australia from Syria's al-Roj detention camp via Damascus, will face the same legal consequences as previous returnees.
summary.zh: 澳大利亚官员表示，第二批与“伊斯兰国”组织有关联的人员正试图从叙利亚的al-Roj拘留营经大马士革返回澳大利亚，他们将面临与此前返澳人员相同的法律后果。

body.en:
A second group of Australian women and children with links to the self-described Islamic State (IS) group have reportedly left a refugee camp in Syria.

Federal minister Tanya Plibersek told the ABC on Friday they would "face the same consequences as the first group".

"If there are any crimes that they're accused of, they'll be taken into custody and treated with the full force of the law," she said.

The group left the al-Roj detention camp on Thursday local time, according to the ABC, which reported it had seen the bus carrying the group.

The bus was reportedly travelling in a convoy escorted by Syrian government officials. It's believed all Australians at the camp have now departed, however camp officials declined to comment.

It is expected they will head towards the capital Damascus for flights returning to Australia, but the timing remains unclear.

It comes after a group of four women and nine children with ties to the IS group arrived in Australia earlier in May after leaving the same refugee camp.

Three of the women in that group were arrested upon their arrival and remain in custody.

Two are facing charges relating to slavery, and the other was charged with joining a terrorist organisation and travelling to a declared conflict zone.

It is understood seven women and 14 children remained at the Syrian al-Roj camp following the departure of the first group.

One of the women has been given a temporary exclusion order, which bans them from entering Australia for a two-year period on national security grounds.

The group can to return to Australia from the refugee camp as they are citizens, but Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has insisted no support has been given to them.

"The US State Department has been very keen on people leaving those camps," he told ABC Radio on Wednesday.

"There wasn't a government person on the plane [with the previous cohort], because we weren't providing any assistance, and won't."

The group is part of at least 34 Australian citizens — mainly women and children — who have been stuck in diplomatic limbo in the al-Roj camp since 2019 following the collapse of the IS group.

The story has generated significant political debate and scrutiny of the government, which has limited powers to prevent Australian citizens from returning home.

The government has firmly stated it has not assisted the group in any way, after facing Opposition backlash and accusations of facilitating the return. The government was under obligation to provide the group with passports and did so earlier this year.

title.en: Can the Quad stay relevant to boost Indo-Pacific security?
title.zh: 四方安全对话能否保持其在提升印太安全方面的相关性？

summary.en: Foreign ministers from the US, India, Japan, and Australia, known as the Quad, must resolve past disagreements to maintain their alliance's effectiveness in addressing Indo-Pacific security challenges.
summary.zh: 美国、印度、日本和澳大利亚四国外长——统称为“四方安全对话”（Quad）——需要搁置过去的分歧，以确保该联盟在应对印太地区安全挑战方面保持有效性。

body.en:
Foreign ministers from the US, India, Japan and Australia — collectively known as the Quad — need to put past differences behind them if the alliance is to remain an effective means of countering China.

Foreign ministers from the US , India, Japan and Australia — the four nations that make up the Quadrilateral Security Dialogue, better known as the Quad — are set to meet in New Delhi over three days from Sunday to discuss Indo-Pacific security, energy supplies and emerging technologies.

The meeting comes as China continues to test geopolitical and security boundaries in the region.

But it's another issue, which is not on the agenda, that looms large over the gathering: how to keep the alliance alive and relevant in an ever more challenging geopolitical landscape and an increasingly assertive China .

The Quad, which unites the four nations in seeking a Free and Open Indo-Pacific (FOIP), has not had a meeting of national leaders since 2024, when then-President Joe Biden hosted his counterparts in Wilmington, Delaware.

India was meant to host the next annual meeting in the latter part of 2025, but that never materialized amid tensions between India and the new administration of President Donald Trump .

Trump has imposed tariffs and punitive duties on Indian imports to the US, straining ties with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi. The US president further antagonized New Delhi by claiming to have mediated a settlement to border clashes between India and Pakistan in May last year . The US president was also critical of India purchasing Russian military equipment .

One year on, Secretary of State Marco Rubio, who is heading the US delegation to India, is tasked with smoothing ruffled diplomatic feathers. With Trump's attention apparently focused on the war in the Middle East and, potentially, Cuba , Rubio's mission could be a challenging one.

"The US, Japan and Australia already had an important and effective trilateral security arrangement, but the whole purpose of the Quad was to bring India in as another power to give it more influence and reach," said James Brown, a professor of international relations at the Tokyo campus of Temple University.

"Unfortunately, this US administration does not seem to have grasped that or valued India's presence as an ally, which has badly alienated Modi," he told DW.

Japan and Australia have made efforts to keep the four-way alliance intact and functioning, with Brown suggesting that the Quad might actually benefit from the US being represented by Rubio, rather than Trump, in India.

title.en: At least 90 dead in Chinese coal mine explosion, state media reports
title.zh: 中国官方媒体报道，中国煤矿爆炸至少造成90人死亡

summary.en: An explosion occurred at a coal mine in northern China on Friday evening, resulting in the deaths of at least 90 people, according to state media reports.
summary.zh: 据中国官方媒体报道，周五晚间中国北方一煤矿发生爆炸，造成至少90人死亡。

body.en:
At least 90 people have been killed in a coal mine blast in northern China, according to the country's state media.

The gas explosion happened at the Liushenyu Coal Mine, run by the Tongzhou Group, in Shanxi Province.

Hundreds of rescuers have been sent to the site. Footage from state media showed paramedics carrying stretchers at the site, with ambulances in the background. More than 100 people are said to have been taken to hospital, with rescue work at the site still under way.

The blast happened at 19:29 local time on Friday (11:29 GMT) at a coal mine in Shanxi, with 247 workers reportedly on duty at the time of the incident.

Following the incident, Chinese President Xi Jinping called for no effort to be spared in efforts to treat the injured and search for survivors.

He also asked the government to investigate the cause of the accident and hold those responsible to account.

Officials running the coal mine have been detained, according to state media. The cause of the gas explosion has not yet been revealed, but state media reported that the levels of carbon monoxide - a highly toxic, odourless gas - in the mine were found to have "exceeded limits".

China's Ministry of Emergency Management has sent 345 personnel from six rescue teams to help with the operation.

Shanxi, one of China's poorer provinces, is known as the country's coal-mining capital.

In the early 2000s, deadly accidents were common in China's coal mining industry. Safety standards have been tightened in recent years, but accidents still occur.

In 2023, a collapse at an open-pit coal mine in the northern Inner Mongolia region killed 53 people.

Back in 2009, an explosion at a mine in Heilongjiang province in the north-east killed more than 100.

China is the world's biggest consumer of coal and the largest emitter of greenhouse gases, even as it installs renewable energy capacity at record speed.
body.zh: 据中国官方媒体报道，中国北方的煤矿爆炸已造成至少 90 人死亡。 瓦斯爆炸发生在山西省通州集团旗下的六神峪煤矿。 数百名救援人员已被派往现场。官方媒体的视频显示，医护人员在现场抬着担架，背景是救护车。据称已有100多人被送往医院，现场救援工作仍在进行中。 爆炸发生在当地时间周五 19 点 29 分（格林威治标准时间 11 点 29 分），山西一煤矿发生爆炸，据报道事发时有 247 名工人在值班。 事件发生后，中国国家主席习近平要求全力救治伤员、搜寻幸存者。 他还要求政府调查事故原因，追究相关责任人的责任。 据官方媒体报道，该煤矿的管理官员已被拘留。瓦斯爆炸的原因尚未公布，但官方媒体报道称，矿井中一氧化碳（一种剧毒、无味的气体）的含量被发现“超出了限度”。 中国应急管理部已派出6支救援队、345名人员协助救援。 山西是中国较贫困的省份之一，被称为中国的煤矿之都。 2000年代初期，中国煤矿行业死亡事故屡见不鲜。近年来，安全标准不断加强，但事故仍时有发生。 2023年，内蒙古北部地区一座露天煤矿发生塌方，造成53人死亡。 早在2009年，东北部黑龙江省的一座矿井发生爆炸，造成100多人死亡。 中国是世界上最大的煤炭消费国和最大的温室气体排放国，尽管它以创纪录的速度安装可再生能源。

reflection.en: The news of so many lives lost in this mine explosion brings profound sorrow and reminds us of the fragility of life. In moments of such deep grief, we hold onto the promise that one day, God will wipe away every tear, and there will be no more death or pain. This hope sustains us even as we mourn with those who suffer.

verse.textZh: 神要擦去他们一切的眼泪；不再有死亡，也不再有悲哀、哭号、疼痛。

title.en: China: Dozens dead in coal mine blast — state media

summary.en: An explosion in a coal mine in northern China has resulted in the deaths of at least 82 people, with some individuals still missing. President Xi Jinping has called for comprehensive efforts to search for and rescue those unaccounted for.

body.en:
An explosion in a coal mine in northern China has killed at least 82 people, with some still unaccounted for, state media say. President Xi Jinping has demanded an "all-out" effort to search for and rescue those missing.

At least 82 people have died after a gas explosion at a coal mine in northern China , state media reported on Saturday.

Rescuers were still searching "intensively" for nine people who remained unaccounted for, according to state news agency Xinhua.

The blast took place at 7:29 pm (1129 GMT/UTC) on Friday at the Liushenyu coal mine in Qinyuan county in Shanxi, one of China's poorer provinces, with 247 ⁠workers ​on duty ​underground, Xinhua said

Xinhua reported that most had been brought safely to ​the surface by early Saturday. 

Earlier, Xinhua said that levels of carbon monoxide had "exceeded limits" at the mine. Some of those trapped underground were in "critical condition," it said.

Chinese President Xi Jinping urged authorities to "spare no ‌effort" in treating the injured and conducting ‌search ​and rescue operations, according to Xinhua.

Xi also ordered a thorough investigation into the cause of the accident and strict ​accountability in accordance with the law.

He stressed that "all regions and departments must draw lessons from this accident, remain constantly vigilant regarding workplace safety ... and resolutely prevent and curb the occurrence of major and catastrophic accidents."

In recent decades, mine safety in China has improved, but accidents are still frequent in an industry where safety protocols are often lax.

title.zh: 美国代理海军部长称，对台湾的军售因伊朗战争而“暂停”

summary.en: Washington's acting navy secretary stated that US arms sales to Taiwan have been temporarily halted. This pause is to ensure sufficient munitions are available for ongoing US military operations in Iran, adding to recent doubts about sustained US support for Taipei.
summary.zh: 华盛顿代理海军部长表示，美国对台湾的军售已暂停。此举是为了确保美国军方有足够的弹药用于其在伊朗的军事行动，这进一步加剧了近期对美国能否持续支持台北的疑虑。

body.en: Hung Cao’s comments are latest blow to Taipei after Donald Trump recently cast doubt over US’s enduring support US arms sales to Taiwan have been “paused” to ensure the US military has enough munitions for its Iran operations, according to Washington’s acting navy secretary, in the latest blow to Taipei after a series of comments by Donald Trump. When asked at a congressional hearing on Thursday about a $14bn (£10.4bn) weapons package awaiting Trump’s signoff for months, Hung Cao said: “Right now we’re doing a pause in order to make sure we have the munitions we need for Epic Fury [the Iran war] – which we have plenty.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 华盛顿代理海军部长表示，唐纳德·特朗普最近对美国的持久支持表示怀疑，美国已“暂停”对台军售，以确保美军有足够的弹药用于其伊朗行动，曹洪的言论是对台北的最新打击。这是唐纳德·特朗普发表一系列言论后对台北的最新打击。在周四的国会听证会上，当被问及等待特朗普签署数月之久的价值 140 亿美元（104 亿英镑）的武器计划时，曹洪表示：“现在我们正在暂停，以确保我们拥有史诗般的愤怒（伊朗战争）所需的弹药——我们有足够的弹药。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: News of arms sales being paused due to another conflict highlights the constant demand for military resources in a world marked by tension. The prophet Isaiah envisioned a future where nations would transform instruments of war into tools for peace, no longer training for battle. This vision calls us to hope for a day when global resources are dedicated to...
reflection.zh: 军售因另一场冲突而暂停的消息，凸显了在一个充满紧张的世界中对军事资源的持续需求。先知以赛亚曾预见一个未来，各国将把战争工具转化为和平工具，不再为战争训练。这一愿景呼唤我们盼望有一天，全球资源将致力于建设生命，而非备战。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Weather tracker: Heavy rain triggers flooding and landslides in parts of China
title.zh: 中国部分地区持续强降雨引发洪灾和山体滑坡

summary.en: Heavy, prolonged rainfall in southern and central China has caused widespread flooding and landslides, leading to the deaths of twelve people. The severe weather has also resulted in significant travel disruption, electricity outages, and evacuations across affected areas.
summary.zh: 中国南方和中部地区持续强降雨引发大范围洪水和山体滑坡，已造成十二人死亡。恶劣天气还导致受灾地区交通中断、电力供应中断，并进行了人员疏散。

body.en: Twelve dead as southern and central areas also suffer travel disruption, electricity outages and evacuations Heavy, prolonged rainfall in southern and central China has resulted in weather warnings for flash flooding, landslides and waterlogging. The slow-moving band of rainfall spanned 620 miles (1,000km) and travelled eastwards across the regions on Tuesday. It was formed from the convergence of multiple bands of rain originating from the Bay of Bengal, South China Sea and Pacific Ocean. Given the accompanying low wind speeds, high daily and hourly rainfall totals have been recorded, with as much as 75mm locally in Hunan, 85mm in Anhui in a 24-hour period, and 95mm on the island of Hainan. Twelve people have died because of the flooding and hundreds of residents have been evacuated by emergency services. There were major travel disruptions, electricity outages, as well as school and business closures. Social media posts showed submerged cars and people fishing along flooded streets. Continue reading...
body.zh: 南部和中部地区也遭遇出行中断、停电和疏散，造成 12 人死亡 中国南部和中部地区持续强降雨，引发山洪、山体滑坡和内涝天气警报。周二，降雨带横跨 1,000 公里（620 英里），并稳步向东移动穿过该地区。这是一条缓慢移动的雨带，由来自孟加拉湾、南中国海和太平洋的多个雨带汇聚而成。加上风速较低，日、小时降雨总量较高，湖南局部24小时降雨量高达75毫米，安徽24小时降雨量高达85毫米，海南岛24小时降雨量高达95毫米。洪水已造成 12 人死亡，数百名居民已被紧急服务部门疏散。出现了严重的旅行中断、停电以及学校和企业关闭的情况。沿着被洪水淹没的街道，社交媒体帖子显示汽车被淹没，人们在钓鱼。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In the face of devastating floods and landslides, communities experience immense loss and disruption. Psalm 46:1 reminds us that even when the earth gives way, God remains our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble. This truth offers a steady anchor for those navigating the chaos and rebuilding their lives.
reflection.zh: 面对毁灭性的洪水和山体滑坡，社区遭受了巨大的损失和破坏。诗篇46:1提醒我们，即使大地动摇，雅伟仍是我们的避难所和力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。这个真理为那些在混乱中挣扎并重建生活的人们提供了稳固的锚。

verse.textEn: God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in trouble.
verse.textZh: 神是我们的避难所，是我们的力量，是我们在患难中随时的帮助。

title.en: Chinese authorities destroy villager’s ramshackle 10-storey Studio Ghibli-esque home
title.zh: 中国当局拆除村民破旧的十层吉卜力风格房屋

summary.en: Officials in Guizhou province, China, demolished a unique 10-storey home in Xingyi village. The unconventional structure had become a local tourist attraction, but authorities stated it lacked the necessary building permits.
summary.zh: 中国贵州省兴义村的一栋独特的十层房屋被当局拆除。这座非传统的建筑已成为当地的旅游景点，但官方表示其缺乏必要的建筑许可证。

body.en: The home in the village of Xingyi in Guizhou province had become a tourist attraction, but officials said it lacked the necessary building permits A ramshackle 10-storey home that had become an offbeat tourist attraction in south-western China has been torn down, ending a years-long battle between the structure’s owner and local authorities. Chen Tianming said local authorities took just hours to return the stone bungalow – which had been transformed into a pyramid-shaped structure of plywood rooms stacked upon one another – back down to its original single storey. Continue reading...
body.zh: 贵州省兴义村的一栋住宅已成为旅游景点，但官员称，它缺乏必要的建筑许可证。一栋摇摇欲坠的10层住宅曾成为中国西南部另类的旅游景点，现已被拆除，结束了业主与地方当局之间长达数年的斗争。陈天明说，当地政府仅用了几个小时就将这座石头平房（已被改造成胶合板房间相互堆叠的金字塔形结构）恢复到原来的单层。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The demolition of a villager's unique home, despite its popularity, highlights the tension between individual initiative and regulatory authority. While governments are tasked with maintaining order, Jeremiah 22:3 reminds leaders of their mandate to "do justice and righteousness," urging a compassionate and balanced application of power that considers the...
reflection.zh: 一位村民独特的房屋被拆除，尽管它很受欢迎，这凸显了个人创造力与监管权力之间的张力。虽然政府的职责是维护秩序，但耶利米书22:3提醒领导者，他们的使命是“施行公平和公义”，敦促他们在执行权力时要富有同情心和平衡，并考虑其决定对人的影响。

verse.textEn: Do what is just and right. Rescue from the hand of the oppressor the one who has been robbed.
verse.textZh: 你们要施行公平和公义，拯救被抢夺的脱离欺压人的手。

title.en: New Chinese surveillance leaves foreigners nowhere to hide
title.zh: 中国新监控系统让外国人无处藏身

summary.en: A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."
summary.zh: 一位中国网络安全专家向德国之声披露了中国高科技警务的详细信息。该系统利用滑雪场的面部识别和火车座位等技术，可以追踪任何人并建立“综合档案”，让外国人无处藏身。

body.en:
A Chinese cybersecurity expert has revealed to DW details of China's new high-tech policing. From ski resort facial recognition to seats on a train, the system can track anyone and compile a "holistic profile."

When a cybersecurity researcher known by the pseudonym NetAskari recently clicked on a tab labeled "Inquiry for journalist files" on an unsecured Chinese web dashboard, he expected to see a jumble of auto-generated mock data.

Instead, familiar faces popped up on the screen. It was a comprehensive database of almost every foreign journalist based in the Chinese capital Beijing around 2021, including official passport photos taken at the entry/exit bureau, private cell phone numbers, visa details, and dates of birth. He also found his own exact personal information lying dormant on this Chinese police watchlist.

"It was more interesting than shocking," NetAskari told DW. "When you work as a journalist in China , you basically assume you are always on their radar. But what surprised me was simply how easy it was to access this highly sensitive system."

What NetAskari had stumbled upon is part modern China's emerging system of "holographic profiles."

He had unwittingly accessed a demonstration version of a remote tracking system designed for the Public Security Bureau in Zhangjiakou, the Hebei province city that hosted the 2022 Winter Olympics.

Though it was only a test panel, it was populated with real datasets, clearly outlining the trajectory of China's state surveillance machine, which is rapidly evolving from a network of simple street cameras into a data-fused, 24/7, predictive social control behemoth.

For years, China has operated the world's most extensive CCTV network. A massive initiative known as the "Xueliang" (Bright Eyes) project aims to merge these isolated islands of surveillance spread across the country.

But the data on the Zhangjiakou police dashboard shows the granular detail with which authorities can track an individual.

This system no longer relies solely on police cameras on street corners. It accurately records the specific train carriage and seat number a target occupies when arriving from Beijing or Shanghai.

It even synchronizes photos taken by facial-recognition ticket gates at local ski resorts directly into its tracking mechanism. The movements of the researcher's acquaintances who recently skied in Zhangjiakou were precisely flagged and mapped out with detailed trajectories in the system.

"The idea is simply to process as much data as possible from as many sensors as possible in real time," the researcher noted.

The system logs daily behaviors like gasoline consumption, regular shopping locations, and whether an individual frequently visits "petition areas."
